family: F-sched-eevdf-overflow: EEVDF vruntime/lag overflow -> WARN under rq->lock -> netconsole-driven rq-lock self-deadlock
root_cause: reweight_entity() rescales a group entity's vlag on a large weight decrease without re-clamping it to the lag limit, so se->vruntime drifts far below cfs_rq->zero_vruntime; __enqueue_entity()'s entity_key()*weight overflows and trips the WARN_ON_ONCE in __sum_w_vruntime_add()/avg_vruntime accounting while rq->lock is held, corrupting avg-vruntime/rb-tree ordering and wedging the load balancer (the WARN's printk to netconsole on bnxt can additionally self-deadlock on the held rq lock).
fatal_mechanism: hard lockup (NMI watchdog): CPUs spinning in queued_spin_lock_slowpath on rq->lock from sched_balance_rq/_nohz_idle_balance
